en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Al Moalla Abu Usman, from Moalla Bin Khunays,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is dislike that the one in Ihraam should sleep upon a yellow bed or upon a yellow bed-spread’.
en.sarwar: 11. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not touch any fragrance while you are in the state of Ihram, or anything in which there is saffron, and do not taste any food with saffron in it.’”
